//: Next.js-scoped tsconfig (Phase 2 coexistence). Next type-checks ONLY its own surface (app/ + the shared lib/ it imports) — NOT the legacy Vite SPA (src/) or the Express server (server.ts), which keep their own check via the root tsconfig + `npm run lint`. next.config.ts points Next at this file (typescript.tsconfigPath), so Next mutates THIS file, leaving the root tsconfig pristine for Vite. Phase 3 folds src/ into app/ and retires this split.
